name: ros2_controllers joint-state broadcaster implementation
summary: Official C++ ros2_control plugin that claims no command interfaces, reads configured DOUBLE state interfaces and publishes JointState plus optional DynamicJointState ROS messages. Interface mapping, URDF filtering and incomplete readings have explicit source-defined behavior; runtime and hardware behavior remain untested.
robots: unspecified ros2_control system exposing joint state interfaces

packages: Complete pinned joint_state_broadcaster package, generated parameter header/YAML and a C++17 toolchain
system: Configured ros2_control controller manager/lifecycle host and DOUBLE joint state interfaces
Matching joint/interface selections, topic namespace, frame and mapping parameters; robot description for optional URDF-based filtering
requirements.notes: command_interface_configuration returns NONE; the plugin reads loaned state interfaces and publishes ROS messages. Empty joints or interfaces selects all available state interfaces; otherwise the configured cross-product is requested. Non-DOUBLE interfaces are ignored. The selected source supports custom interface mapping, optional URDF filtering/order and configured extra joints initialized to zero. update attempts get_optional(0) once per DOUBLE interface and retains prior values on failed reads; never-read values can remain NaN. JointState carries position/velocity/effort; DynamicJointState is conditional. Unprefixed or ~/ topic names depend on use_local_topics. Complete source/header/package/CMake/plugin XML were read; parameter YAML/generated header and dependency implementations were not. Parameter defaults, timing, publication success, data freshness and physical compatibility were not tested. CMake >=3.16, C++17 and package 4.43.0 are declarations, not tested environment combinations. Optional BUILD_TESTING has additional declared dependencies.

invocation.notes: joint_state_plugin.xml registers type joint_state_broadcaster::JointStateBroadcaster, base controller_interface::ControllerInterface and shared library joint_state_broadcaster. This selected source exports that same pair with PLUGINLIB_EXPORT_CLASS; CMake builds that shared library and exports the XML. A configured controller manager invokes its lifecycle and update callbacks. This is not a standalone executable or Hub adapter. Loading it can expose hardware state through joint_states and optional dynamic_joint_states ROS topics; this source requests no command interface. Fetching the reference neither loads the plugin nor executes it.

access.instructions: Read the immutable source/header, complete license and package/CMake/plugin registration, then review the upstream parameter definitions and configured controller-manager host before integration. This source-only reference supplies no build, install or execution adapter.
